entries.name: Marvin Allen Davidov

expected_cases.charges: Trespass (Honeywell Project sit-ins at Honeywell HQ, Minneapolis, 1968–2002)
expected_cases.sentence: Individual custodial sentences and endpoints for the Honeywell campaign remain unresolved. The former October 23, 1983 arrest/admission dates were unsupported: the contemporary court opinion dates the mass action October 24 but does not individually establish Davidov's arrest or prison admission. The December 12, 1986 Nuclear Resister reports a separate recent trespass conviction and one day of community service, not one day in prison. Group acquittals, group jail totals, and community-service orders must not be counted as Davidov's custody.

case.charges: Breach of the peace - June 11, 1961 Freedom Ride at the Jackson bus terminal
case.convicted: Yes - breach of the peace; conviction appealed
case.sentence: Sentenced to four months in jail following the June 11, 1961 Freedom Ride arrest. Initially jailed in Jackson, then transferred to Parchman. Released July 24, 1961 on appeal bond; the subsequent appeal was not continuous custody.

entries.rationale: MNHS names Davidov among five male Minnesota riders detained June11 and released July24. New independent 1961 episode; preserve unrelated Honeywell case.
